book/sealed-harbor.tex.text: For the checkout diagnosis, the first secret read labels the worker; it does
not end the computation. The worker may continue reasoning and using tools
inside the room under the work order. A request to an outside tool is itself
an output and needs an authorized release channel. When a result is ready,
the worker submits it to the pre-authorized slot: the gate checks the declared
release function, recipient, schema and remaining budget before anything
leaves. An approved release does not clear the worker's taint. Later turns
remain subject to the same gates until the job is destroyed.

book/federated-harbor-whitepaper.tex.text: It is worth saying what the federation is not, so that the rest of the chapter does not have to keep refuting positions it never took.
The purpose of the topology here is diagnostic: identify which communication
links leave cycle checks blind, produce a certificate when visible differences
cannot fit one consistent assignment, and measure the least unrestricted
numerical correction that would restore consistency. Effective resistance
will quantify the sensitivity to an offset on one edge. If the auditor already
has comparable signed claims from the same sender and snapshot, direct
comparison retains information that an edge residual can discard. The value
of the geometric calculation is therefore its topology audit and repair
analysis, not superior detection from those same complete records.
